SYNTHETIC TEST JUDGMENT - invented for LexFlow's automated tests. It is not a real judgment, has no legal authority and must never be cited.

Ramesh Iyer v. QuickMart Online (SYNTHETIC)
SYNTHETIC High Court (test fixture)
Decided: 2024-04-05

The consumer paid for a refrigerator that was never delivered, and the seller ignored repeated complaints. The commission held that failure to deliver goods or refund the price within a reasonable time is deficiency in service and an unfair trade practice. A full refund with compensation for harassment was ordered.
